messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- Yuki is the primary on-call for team Cinder as of 2025-12-15, taking over from Diego. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego is the primary on-call for team Cinder as of 2025-11-25, taking over from Yuki. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki is the primary on-call for team Cinder as of 2025-10-02. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
- The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-28]
- Yuki is the primary on-call to contact for anything on Cinder as of 2025-12-15. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego is the primary on-call to contact for anything on Cinder as of 2025-11-25; Yuki is off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki is the primary on-call to contact for anything on Cinder as of 2025-10-02; Diego is off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Page Diego for anything on Cinder this cycle, as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Page Yuki for anything on Cinder this cycle, not Diego Alvarez, as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
    earlier: Page Diego Alvarez for anything on Cinder this cycle, not Yuki Tanaka, as of 2025-06-13. [decision; valid 2025-06-13 to 2025-07-22; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-13]
    earlier: Page Yuki Tanaka for anything on Cinder this cycle, not Diego, as of 2025-02-17. [decision; valid 2025-02-17 to 2025-06-13; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-17]
- Billing-api depends on the flags service as of 2025-10-21. [valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-03]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Tomasz is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation as of 2025-12-08. [decision; valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
    earlier: Tomasz is off the Team Dune on-call rotation as of 2025-11-03. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-03]
- Tomasz is off the Team Atlas on-call rotation as of 2025-07-16. [decision; valid 2025-07-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-16]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Atlas goes to Tomasz. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Dune goes to Farah. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
- The first on-call rotation for team Ember goes to Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-13]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns the service the ledger depends on?
